issues: The evolve linkage is incomplete/incorrect: this card has two distinct evolve options, so `evolvesTo` and a single `evolveCost` do not faithfully represent the source. Remove the single `evolvesTo`/`evolveCost` shortcut and encode both evolve abilities with their respective costs: [cost01] for "Celia, Hope's Strategist" and [cost04] for "Celia, Despair's Messenger".
The first `timing: "evolve"` ability is missing the required activated cost for [cost01]. Add the evolve cost/payment to this ability so it represents "[evolve] [cost01]".
The second `timing: "evolve"` ability is missing the required activated cost for [cost04]. Add the evolve cost/payment to this ability so it represents "[evolve] [cost04]".

The fanfare is incomplete: it must also encode "Necrocharge (10) - Put both instead." Add a Necrocharge (10) branch/conditional so the fanfare summons both Mimi and Coco into the EX area instead of choosing one when the condition is met.

The Necrocharge (10) fanfare branch targets are encoded incorrectly. "Give them Storm" refers to the two tokens just summoned, but the parsed `grantKeyword` targets use unsupported/incorrect target filtering on `selfFollower`. Encode this as granting Storm to the summoned Mimi and Coco correctly, matching the two tokens created by the fanfare.

The activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly. The source says "[act] [engage], bury another follower"; use the implemented activated cost shape with `engage: true` and `buryFromField` matching one follower with `excludeSelf`, rather than custom fields like `buryFieldCount` and `excludeSelfFromBury`.

The triggered discard ability is encoded incorrectly. `timing: "onDamaged"` means "when this follower takes damage", but the source says "During your turn, whenever this deals damage to an enemy leader". This should be encoded as a trigger for this follower dealing damage to the enemy leader during your turn; implement a new trigger/effect support for "when this deals damage to a leader" (with turn restriction) and use that to apply `opponentDiscardEach` 1.
